nodes.description: Private storage string _baseTokenURI holding the ERC721 base URI.
Private address _royaltyReceiver receiving royalty payments (EIP-2981).
Private uint256 _royaltyBps royalty share in basis points.
Private address _owner in OwnableUpgradeable, controls onlyOwner functions.
Private bool _initialized guarding one-time initializer execution.
msg.sender / _msgSender() used for ownership, approval and delegatecall authorization checks.
block.timestamp is an attacker-influenceable environment value available to the contract.
Public initializer setting name, symbol, base URI, royalty info and minting the initial supply.
External onlyOwner mint of an arbitrary tokenId to an arbitrary address.
External onlyOwner setter updating royalty receiver and royalty BPS.
Internal override restricting UUPS upgrades to the owner.
External function executing a batch of delegatecalls on this contract.
Private helper performing delegatecall(target,data) using AddressUpgradeable.verifyCallResult.
External view returning royalty receiver and royalty amount for a sale price.
Public burn restricted to owner or approved operator of the tokenId.
External onlyProxy UUPS upgrade entry point calling _authorizeUpgrade then _upgradeToAndCallSecure.
External payable onlyProxy UUPS upgrade with arbitrary delegatecall data.
Private callback invoking onERC721Received on the recipient contract during safe transfers/mints.
Public onlyOwner ownership transfer writing _owner.
Public onlyOwner function setting owner to the zero address.
Internal virtual _setRoyaltyInfo writing _royaltyReceiver and _royaltyBps.
Internal _safeMint that mints and then calls the ERC721 receiver hook.
Internal _mint updating balances/owners and invoking the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Internal hook executed before every mint, burn and transfer.
Library function sending ETH with a low-level call forwarding all gas.
Low-level delegatecall executed inside multicall helper with caller-supplied data.
Low-level delegatecall used by ERC1967/UUPS upgrade path with caller-supplied implementation and data.
Low-level call{value:amount}("") transferring ETH to an untrusted recipient.
Token name parameter of initialize.
Token symbol parameter of initialize.
Base token URI parameter of initialize written to _baseTokenURI.
Royalty basis-points parameter of setRoyaltyInfo and initialize.
Number of tokens minted in the initialize loop.
Recipient of the minted initial supply in initialize.
Destination address parameter of safeMint.
Token id parameter of safeMint and burn.
Calldata array parameters forwarded to delegatecall in multicall and upgradeToAndCall.
New implementation address parameter of upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall/_authorizeUpgrade.
Sale price parameter used in the royalty amount computation.
Computed royalty amount returned by royaltyInfo.
Previous implementation address cached during _upgradeToAndCallSecure rollback test.
Previous owner cached in _setOwner before writing _owner.
ETH amount parameter forwarded to the low-level call in sendValue.

edges.reason: _msgSender() is stored into _owner by _setOwner during initialization and ownership transfer.
initialize writes baseTokenURI_ into the _baseTokenURI state variable.
Parameter baseTokenURI_ flows into _baseTokenURI.
initialize calls _setRoyaltyInfo for the royalty configuration.
royaltyBps_ is forwarded into _setRoyaltyInfo.
_setRoyaltyInfo assigns the receiver to _royaltyReceiver.
_setRoyaltyInfo assigns royaltyBps_ to _royaltyBps.
initialize mints the initial supply by calling _safeMint in a loop.
initialSupply_ controls the number of iterations of the mint loop.
initialSupplyReceiver_ is passed as recipient to _safeMint.
safeMint delegates the minting to the internal _safeMint.
The to parameter is forwarded to _safeMint.
The tokenId parameter is forwarded to _safeMint.
safeMint is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier checking _msgSender().
setRoyaltyInfo is guarded by onlyOwner checking _msgSender().
setRoyaltyInfo calls the internal _setRoyaltyInfo.
royaltyBps_ argument flows into setRoyaltyInfo.
_authorizeUpgrade is restricted with onlyOwner, authorizing upgrades for _msgSender().
newImplementation is passed to _authorizeUpgrade.
upgradeTo invokes _authorizeUpgrade before upgrading.
upgradeToAndCall invokes _authorizeUpgrade before upgrading.
upgradeTo performs a delegatecall through _upgradeToAndCallSecure.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls the new implementation with caller data.
The data argument of upgradeToAndCall is executed in the upgrade delegatecall.
multicall loops over data calling _multicallFunctionDelegateCall(address(this), data[i]).
The helper executes target.delegatecall(data), giving arbitrary code execution in the contract context.
Caller-supplied calldata is forwarded into the multicall delegatecall helper.
The delegatecall executes in this contract's storage context and can write _baseTokenURI.
The upgrade delegatecall path caches oldImplementation for the rollback test.
royaltyInfo reads _royaltyReceiver for the receiver return value.
royaltyInfo reads _royaltyBps for the royalty amount computation.
salePrice_ flows into the royaltyInfo computation.
royaltyAmount = (salePrice_ * _royaltyBps) / 10000 is a multiplication/division computation.
burn requires _isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId) before destroying the token.
_safeMint calls _mint to create the token.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state updates.
_safeMint calls onERC721Received on the recipient contract before the mint is finalized.
_msgSender() is passed as the operator argument to the external onERC721Received callback.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner checking _msgSender().
renounceOwnership zeroes the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner checking _msgSender().
sendValue performs the low-level call{value: amount}("") after the balance check.
The amount argument is used as the value of the outbound ETH call.
The value transfer forwards control to an untrusted recipient that may reenter the contract.
Timestamp environment value is available to royalty-related external view entry points.

normalization_plan.reason: Token name parameter is only used by the initialize function's ERC721 initialization.
Token symbol parameter is only used by the initialize function's ERC721 initialization.
baseTokenURI_ is consumed by initialize when writing _baseTokenURI.
royaltyBps_ is passed through to the _setRoyaltyInfo core function.
initialSupply_ only controls the mint loop inside initialize.
initialSupplyReceiver_ is only used as mint recipient inside initialize.
Destination address is consumed by the safeMint external function.
tokenId is consumed by the safeMint external function.
Calldata payloads are forwarded into the multicall delegatecall helper.
newImplementation is consumed by the upgradeTo core function and its authorization path.
salePrice_ is only used inside the royaltyInfo computation.
royaltyAmount is a local result of the royaltyInfo arithmetic.
oldImplementation is a local of the upgrade path triggered by upgradeToAndCall.
oldOwner is a local temporary of the ownership update flow used by transferOwnership.
amount is the transferred value consumed by the sendValue core function.
